facts.value: Official JLPT N1 has a 110-minute Language Knowledge (Vocabulary/Grammar) and Reading section plus a 55-minute Listening section.

facts.source_locator: Official exam-structure review, JLPT N1 and N2
facts.value: Official JLPT N2 has a 105-minute Language Knowledge (Vocabulary/Grammar) and Reading section plus a 50-minute Listening section.
Each self-authored JLPT N2 and N1 practice v1 bank covers vocab_mc, grammar_fill, kanji_reading, and listening.
Official TOPIK I IBT uses Listening and Reading for grades 1-2; TOPIK II IBT uses Listening, Reading, and Writing for grades 3-6.
The self-authored TOPIK owner Batch 6 covers grades 3 through 6 across vocab, grammar, reading, listening, and writing.
Official TOPIK I PBT uses Listening and Reading for grades 1-2; TOPIK II PBT uses Listening, Reading, and Writing for grades 3-6.
